title: Position CTR Curve + AIO Discount v1.0
description: Versioned, machine-readable per-position organic CTR curve and AI-Overview discount factors, consumed by the quick-win opportunity scorer (scripts/util/ctr_curve.py + scripts/discovery/quickwins_transform.py). Honors measurement-discipline R-139 (versioned measurement constants): CTR/AIO numbers live here with provenance fields, never as literals in Python/SKILL bodies. The engine ships a curated seed (ctr-curve.json at repo root, same layout as mcp-tool-registry.json / google-update-calendar.json); curve_version bumps when a newer study lands. Positions 11-20 are engine_estimate fallback-only (the scorer's target is always page-1 by design). AIO factors come from the Ahrefs 2026-02 300K-keyword study; unknown/unchecked AIO presence is NOT discounted (factor 1.0) — see R-140.

schema_version.description: File schema version. Additive changes keep this const (ADR-018 precedent).

curve_version.description: Data version of the curve itself (e.g. '2026.06'); bumps when the underlying study changes.

sources.description: Provenance for every number in the file. No fabricated curves — each source carries a real URL + retrieval date.

positions.description: Per-position CTR anchors, strictly increasing by position (loader enforces strict monotonicity). expected_ctr() interpolates linearly between listed positions and clamps at the ends.

ctr.description: Expected organic click-through rate at this position on a clean SERP (fraction 0-1).

provenance.description: Where this CTR value came from. 'engine_estimate' marks fallback-only 11-20 values.

interpolation.description: Interpolation contract between listed positions (loader implements exactly this).

aio_discount.description: Multiplicative CTR discount applied ONLY when an AI Overview is present (R-140). Factor in (0,1]; 1.0 would mean no discount.

default.description: Cross-check default discount (Pew ~-47% ⇒ 0.5) used when a per-position factor is unavailable.

fallback_11_20.description: Discount factor for target positions 11-20 (rarely reached — scorer targets page 1).
